blocks.source: Vol III, Conclusion, § Fallacies and Pitfalls
blocks.md: Accepting an automated remediation safely depends on keeping four concerns apart: capability, enforcement, evidence, and accountability. Even when the model proposes an accurate diagnosis and a valid fix, each answers a different question, and conflating them lets a locally successful component close the task before the environment has verified the result.

points: You have worked through Fallacies and Pitfalls.
